## Primary Projects & Software Ecosystem
- **OpenPrism** (https://openprism.pages.dev): Long-term fact-verification and counter-misinformation platform built on "Facts over Numbers and Noise". Currently 30% complete, targeting full deployment by Mid-2027.
- **RALogs** (https://ralogs.pages.dev): Enterprise internal operations, logging, and automated reporting tool built for employees of Rashmi Associates. Supporting 20-30 daily staff and providing performance metrics for 100+ stakeholders (Active from 20 OCT 2026).
- **Meshage** (https://meshage.pages.dev): Privacy-first in-memory web communications tool featuring WebRTC audio and ephemeral browser memory (formerly nomesh.pages.dev). Interlinked with DotPixels.
- **DotPixels** (https://dotpixels.pages.dev): Browser game sandbox integrated with Meshage. Currently running 1 LAN title; expanding to 10 single-player and 2 online multiplayer games by 20 OCT 2026.
- **Rashmi Associates** (http://www.rashmiassociates.com): Corporate web platform designed and actively managed.
- **Milele Desktop Utility**: Desktop software suite engineered in Python 3 with PyQt6 and MySQL storage.
